Name: Warp Calculator
Author: XxHarvzBackxX
Description:
Simple tool for modders that writes a warp script for you.

It will explain what you need to do when you run it, but the basic premise is that it asks if your map is vertical or horizontal (not the way the character will warp, but the direction that the warps will be), then ask for a map name (where you're warping), then for starting coords, and then a height or width (how many warp scripts should be calculated), and then finally a set of destination coords. The result will be a long warp script which you can paste into the 'Warp | (script here)' property on your map.


[b][u]Install:
[/u][/b]Unzip the folder.
Navigate to:
[b]bin -> Debug -> net 5.0 -> Warp Calculator.exe[/b]
Run, and enjoy the tool!

[size=6][b][i][u]NOTE: THIS IS A TOOL FOR MODDERS, NOT A TOOL FOR GAMEPLAY.[/u][/i][/b][/size]
